notes: The nominated clause states that this permit supersedes and replaces the prior NM0020583 permit issued September 30, 2016. Federal FY2025 (2024-10-01 through 2025-09-30) falls entirely within this permit's effective period (2021-12-01 through 2026-11-30). Interpreting the supersession language does not create a computation-changing ambiguity about which enforceable limits apply (Purpose A), which monitoring requirements govern (Purpose B), or how missing-evidence cases should be classified (Purpose C); the effective and expiration dates on the same cover page already establish that this permit document governs FY2025.
